name: noodle
description: Operate the Noodle CLI — explain commands, find flags, create/edit .noodle.toml config. Also covers writing skills for Noodle: the orders pipeline, task-type schedule fields, stage composition, and the orders-next.json schema. Use when running noodle commands, editing .noodle.toml, writing or updating a skill's schedule field, authoring new task-type skills, or asking "how to run noodle", "noodle help", "configure noodle".
